step_by_step_reasoning: We first identify the visual components representing AWS services on the whiteboard: Kinesis, DMS, Step Functions, EMR, S3, Athena, Redshift, SageMaker, and QuickSight. We map these to their respective AWS service identifiers. We then extract connections based strictly on the arrows drawn on the board: data flows from ingestion sources (Kinesis, DMS) to S3; an orchestrator and processing loop runs between S3 and EMR; and S3 distributes data to consumption services (Athena, Redshift, SageMaker). Finally, we map downstream links from SageMaker to Athena and Redshift, and QuickSight to Redshift.

nodes.name: Amazon EMR

nodes.name: Amazon Redshift

edges.notes: EMR reads raw landing data from S3.
EMR writes processed Parquet back to S3.
Athena queries data in S3 catalog.
SageMaker reads bulk data from S3.
Queries are federated or matched with Redshift.
SageMaker pulls aggregated features from Redshift.
